name: Brass Tyrant

Traits.name: Molten Seams
Traits.text: A creature that touches the tyrant or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 10 (3d6) Fire damage.
Traits.expresses: a body of burning brass and molten slag

Traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
Traits.text: If the tyrant fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

Traits.name: Aura of Authority
Traits.text: While in a 10-foot Emanation originating from the tyrant, the tyrant and its allies have Advantage on attack rolls and saving throws, provided the tyrant doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.

Actions.name: Multiattack
Actions.text: The tyrant makes two Slag-Fling attacks.

Actions.name: Slag-Fling
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +12, reach 10 ft. 15 (2d8 + 6) Bludgeoning damage plus 13 (3d8) Fire damage.

Legendary Actions.name: Legendary Action Uses: 3
Legendary Actions.text: Immediately after another creature's turn, the tyrant can expend a use to take one of the following actions. It regains all expended uses at the start of each of its turns.

Legendary Actions.name: Hold the Line
Legendary Actions.text: The tyrant moves up to half its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks, and it makes one Slag-Fling attack.

Legendary Actions.name: Rally the Forges
Legendary Actions.text: One ally of the tyrant that can see or hear it can immediately use its Reaction to move up to half its Speed or to make one attack.

Legendary Actions.name: Quell Dismay
Legendary Actions.text: The tyrant and each of its allies within 10 feet of it that can see or hear it end the Charmed and Frightened conditions on themselves.

Bonus Actions.name: Retaliatory Slag
Bonus Actions.text: One creature within 5 feet that hit the tyrant with an attack roll since the end of the tyrant's last turn takes 13 (3d8) Fire damage.

lore: Forged from the runoff of a thousand slag-heaps, the Brass Tyrant quenched its rivals in the same crucible and now rules a foundry-city from the smelter-throne, demanding ceaseless tribute of ore and obedience.

generation.userConcept: a tyrant of burning brass who rules a city of forges

immunities: Poison; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned
monsterDescription: a tyrant of burning brass who rules a city of forges
